answers.core: The shading language can't be modified by a script or add-on, and this would improve the performance of shaders because the extra float value for alpha wouldn't have to be included when it isn't needed.
answers.workaround: Using a `vec4` instead of a `vec3` and ignoring the alpha value.

title: Shading language: Allow using `hint_color` with `vec3` to designate a uniform as a color with no alpha
